grammarFocus: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门。
title: Healthy Habits and Rest: A Conversation at the Community Centre
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先读题，再听录音；建议第一遍抓大意，第二遍核对细节。共 10 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用录音中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。判断题 True 表示原文明示支持，False 表示原文明示矛盾，Not Given 表示缺少判断所需信息。
transcript:
Tom: Hi Mei. You look tired today. Are you OK?
Mei: I'm fine, but I went to bed late last night because I watched a film.
Tom: You should go to bed earlier. I always sleep for eight hours. It's the best habit for me.
Mei: I usually sleep for six hours. I'm busy with work this week.
Tom: Six hours is not enough for me. What exercise do you enjoy?
Mei: I prefer swimming to running. Running is boring. Swimming is more fun than running.
Tom: I run every morning. Running is the best way to start the day, for me. But swimming is also very good exercise.
Mei: I swim once a week, on Sundays. I want to go more often.
Tom: You could try two or three times a week.
Mei: I won't add another swim this week. I'm too busy. Maybe next week.
Tom: What about food? You should eat more vegetables and fruit.
Mei: I eat fruit every day, but I don't like vegetables.
Tom: Try some different ones. Some are sweet, like carrots. Carrots are sweeter than potatoes.
Mei: Maybe I can try carrots in my lunch tomorrow. I can buy some at the market.
Tom: Another idea is to take breaks when you work. Stand up and walk for five minutes every hour.
Mei: That's useful. I sit at my computer for a long time and forget to move.
Tom: I put a note beside my screen to remind me.
Mei: Thanks for your advice, Tom. I'll make a note too.

answers: She went to bed late because she watched a film.

grammar.title: because / so; should; 比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: 1. because 表示原因，so 表示结果。例如：I went to bed late because I watched a film. (因为看电影所以晚睡) / I was tired, so I went to bed early. (累了所以早睡)。2. should 表示“应该”，用于给出建议。例如：You should go to bed earlier. 3. 比较级用于比较两者，最高级用于三者或以上。例如：sweeter than (比…更甜)，the best (最好的)。
grammar.example: You should go to bed earlier.

questions.prompt: Choose the word that introduces a result: I was cold, ______ I put on a coat.
questions.explanation: 冷是原因，穿外套是结果，用 so。
questions.evidence: I was cold, so I put on a coat.

questions.prompt: Give positive advice: You ______ take a break.
questions.explanation: 给出“应该休息”的正面建议，用 should。

questions.prompt: This book is ______ than that one.
questions.explanation: 比较两本书用比较级 more interesting。
questions.evidence: This book is more interesting than that one.

questions.prompt: She is ______ student in our class of twenty people.
questions.explanation: 在二十人的班级中比较身高，用带 the 的最高级。
questions.evidence: She is the tallest student in our class of twenty people.
